name: ci_deterministic_pass_rate
measurement_method: Run ci.yml deterministic suite on Python 3.14

name: wheel_package_size
measurement_method: Build offline wheel and stat file

name: wheel_build_latency
measurement_method: Time wheel build in clean temp dir

name: cli_verify_latency
definition: elapsed time of ai-sdlc verify on fixture
limitations: Scales with repo git status & evidence size

name: quickstart_e2e_latency
definition: elapsed time from wheel build through verify PASS

name: claude_smoke_task_cost_and_time
definition: reported total_cost_usd and duration_ms in claude -p --output-format json
limitations: N=1 trivial fixture only; not generalized

name: input_tokens_per_task
definition: sum(input + cache_read + cache_creation tokens) per accepted task
measurement_method: Read agent JSON output or session log
limitations: Unavailable in some interactive UIs (mark UNKNOWN)

name: output_tokens_per_task
measurement_method: Read agent JSON output or session log

name: context_overhead_ratio
measurement_method: Measure Skill+contract prompt size vs total input

name: cost_per_accepted_task
measurement_method: Divide measured spend by human-accepted tasks
limitations: Never derive USD from token counts if unbilled

name: time_to_accepted_task
measurement_method: Record timestamps from task start to Gate 2 accept

name: human_waiting_time
limitations: Overlaps with async work if multitasking

name: first_pass_acceptance_rate
measurement_method: Query Experience journals across pilot tasks

name: pr_cycle_time
limitations: Not equivalent to DORA deployment lead time (DORA metrics are NOT_APPLICABLE without production deployments)
